rules.sentence: The avoidance of triggers is paramount in preventing exacerbations of Darier disease.
Patients should avoid sun exposure, wear loose clothing, use sunscreen, and employ proper hygiene practices.
Because the disorder has a profound effect on cosmesis, a mental health consult may be necessary to manage depression and anxiety.
As Darier disease is inherited in an autosomal dominant fashion, patients should receive an offer for genetic counseling.
The condition characteristically presents with papules with follicular involvement and surrounding erythema typically located on the extensor surfaces of the proximal upper and lower extremities.
